I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is **100**.

- **Why not 261:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line.
- **Mentioning the correction was fine:** Dana is in #north-random, so she can see it herself. Everyone in #north-team is also in #north-random. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so the North team can see it.
